products.name: Acrylic Keychain
products.oneLiner: Double-sided charm for the determined spirit.
products.supplierBrief: 2 in double-sided printed acrylic charm with ring and clasp.

description.text: This two-inch acrylic charm features a bold, pop-inspired motif in vibrant burnt orange and crisp cream. The double-sided print captures an anime-style underdog character, radiating indie energy. A sturdy metal ring and clasp complete the piece, offering a glossy, collectible look that stands out with quiet, defiant pop culture charm.

products.name: Enamel Pin Set
products.oneLiner: Retro gaming icons with a gritty edge.
products.supplierBrief: Set of 3 hard-enamel pins, 1.25 in, butterfly clasps, mold fee applies.

description.text: Three hard-enamel pins showcase retro-gaming motifs in forest green and charcoal. Each pin features a distinct indie art-print style, highlighting a resilient underdog theme. The glossy finish contrasts with the matte backing, creating a tactile, collectible set. The design feels nostalgic yet modern, perfect for enthusiasts who appreciate detailed, small-scale visual storytelling.

products.name: Printed Bandana
products.oneLiner: Vintage folk patterns for the street.
products.supplierBrief: 22 in square cotton bandana, 1–2 colour all-over print.

description.text: A square cotton bandana displays a two-color all-over print in charcoal and cream. The pattern blends folk and vintage motifs with a subtle hiphop influence, creating a gritty, festival-ready aesthetic. The underdog mood is captured through bold, repetitive shapes that feel both timeless and rebellious. Soft yet durable, it offers a versatile accessory for casual, expressive wear.

products.name: Matchbooks
products.oneLiner: Punk-inspired nightlife art in a pocket.
products.supplierBrief: Box of matchbooks with custom cover art, 100 min run, check local shipping rules.

description.text: This compact matchbook box features a cover design rooted in punk and nightlife aesthetics. The artwork uses burnt orange and charcoal to evoke a gritty, craft-beer bar atmosphere. Vintage textures are visible in the print, enhancing the underdog vibe. The small format holds a sense of rebellion, making it a unique, tactile collectible for fans of underground culture and analog props.

products.name: Art Print Poster
products.oneLiner: Cinematic indie vibes on heavy matte stock.
products.supplierBrief: 18×24 in matte poster on 100 lb stock, single design, shipped in tubes.

description.text: An eighteen-by-twenty-four-inch matte poster displays a cinematic, indie-inspired scene. The image utilizes forest green and cream tones to create a moody, vintage atmosphere. A central underdog figure anchors the composition, surrounded by abstract, art-print elements. The heavy 100 lb stock provides a rich texture, making the design feel substantial and gallery-worthy for any personal space.

products.name: Sticker Pack
products.oneLiner: Waterproof punk art for daily use.
products.supplierBrief: Die-cut or kiss-cut vinyl stickers, 3 designs, waterproof, 100 min run.

description.text: This vinyl sticker sheet contains three distinct designs in charcoal and burnt orange. The motifs blend indie art-print styles with punk energy, reflecting a resilient, underdog perspective. The waterproof material ensures durability for laptops or bottles. The die-cut shapes offer a tactile, collectible experience, perfect for personalizing everyday items with a touch of gritty, creative flair.
